text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Sweep Tosho and Zenno Rob Roy are both on fire!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: They're both running in the autumn Tenno Sho, right?! Who do you think's gonna win?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho, end of story! She just won the Takarazuka Kinen! Strength is strength, and she's got it in spades!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! There's no way Rob Roy's losing! She's just not the kinda runner who'd let a loss or two throw her off!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: This is our hero we're talking about! She's gonna slay that witch and take back the number one spot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: … "Take it back," huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… One more set!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: …Rob Roy, can I talk to you for a second?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh?! Of course. How can I help?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: What made you decide to take this on?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Take what on, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Sorry. It's just, I was reading about you… and I just had to know.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: You seem completely different than how you were before your classic year.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: I don't mean to be rude or anything, but you were so introverted and, well, you seemed kinda weak.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Even when you were doing interviews, you seemed sort of jittery.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Especially after the Derby, during the press conference and stuff. You looked like you were sad you couldn't live up to people's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: You looked like you didn't want anyone to talk to you…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …Oh. Haha… Um… So it was that obvious, huh…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: But then, all of a sudden, you weren't afraid anymore.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: You were amazing in your senior year, and were even named Umamusume of the Year… And then you suddenly started opening up about your goals.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Even now, you're getting ready to take on a new challenge. I can tell from your face how determined you are.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: So… what happened?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Where did you get the courage? …Aren't you scared?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …I am scared.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even now, my voice trembles when I talk about my goals. But you know…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sweep cast her magic on me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: …! Sweep did?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's just as you said. All I did was disappoint people in my classic year.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even talking about my dream of being a hero seemed absurd. I felt so pathetic. It was embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But then one day… I caught sight of this selfish, reckless, blinding light.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And when I saw that shining star… I couldn't help but hope to shine that way myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Once that spark was lit, there was no putting it out. My heart had already caught fire.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You've seen it before too, so I think you know the feeling. Her magic is so amazing it's almost frightening.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The closer I get to that light, the more I want it for myself. It's unfair… and frustrating…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Whatever notions of quitting I harbored inside, her magic burned them all away.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: …It's not just you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: I felt frustrated too, watching her run. I felt that way at the Oka Sho. And at the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: But no matter how frustrating it is, some things are just plain impossible!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: …I mean, I saw her myself. I saw her on TV, running in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: I felt like I couldn't even stand on the same ground as her—like there was an invisible wall between us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: So why…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Why do I still feel so frustrated? Why…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Enough with that crap! Don't whine about what's normal or the way things are. Just smash it all up with magic!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Why do I want her to smash it all up?
